versions.changelog:
**This version deprecates the previous skill and removes all phase/flow files.**

- Skill is now marked as DEPRECATED and guides users to install @superior-ai/superiortrade from https://clawhub.ai/superior-ai/superiortrade.
- All sub-files related to authentication, backtesting, deployment, monitoring, and strategy building have been removed.
- SKILL.md significantly simplified and updated with new deprecation and migration instructions.
- No functional API or workflow logic remains; this version exists only to redirect users to the new source.

- Skill name changed to "Superior Trade (Deprecating)" to indicate planned deprecation.
- No functional or logic changes; version, description, and documentation remain unchanged.
- All user guidance, safety, and operating rules are maintained.

No changes detected in this version.

- No file changes or updates from the previous release.
- Functionality and documentation remain the same.

**Version 2.0.1 — Major authentication and flow update**

- API key management simplified: No more user wallet private keys or Hyperliquid credentials needed — only a Superior Trade API key, now obtained at https://account.superior.trade.
- Platform-managed trading wallets: Users no longer need to create or import their own Hyperliquid wallet for live trading.
- Multi-file skill structure: Split into router (main) and phase-specific files for auth, backtesting, deployment, monitoring, and strategy-building.
- Updated safety and privacy rules: Never request or handle private keys, seed phrases, or wallet details from users.
- Improved phase detection and guidance for moving between idea, backtest, deployment, and monitoring steps.
- Documentation and endpoint URLs updated for clarity and new platform flows.
HIP-3 multi-dex support, DCA patterns, verification-first principle, TA-Lib safety docs, order minimums, pre-deployment checklist
Clarify Hyperliquid candle limits, pairlist/protection support, and iteration limits
Rename display name to Superior Trade
Production release: comprehensive security overhaul, credential transparency, Security Policy
ClawHub feedback: transparency (show on request), homepage/source links, explicit confirmation for credentials and live deployment
Improved readability: API quick-reference table, structured magic-link flow, blockquote callouts
